name: Kawakami (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kawakami village emblem in white: a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kawakami, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1988.

features.role: Kawakami village emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised character
